blurb.zh: 蒙山脚下最穷的猎户家，出了个嘴最贫的孩子。为了一张鹿皮，他越过「勿入」的断碑，捡回一只断了八尾、饿得发慌、连自己名字都想不起来的仙界妖王。她吃了他最后一张饼，许了他一个愿——从此，他的倒霉人生，一路开挂。
blurb.en: The poorest hunter's family under Mount Meng has the mouthiest child. For one deer hide he crosses the stone that says Do Not Enter, and carries home a queen of heaven's foxes — eight tails cut away, starving, unable to recall her own name. She eats his last flatbread and owes him a wish. From then on, his luckless life takes off.

_form: 《鹿鼎记》's form (Hanli 2026-09-29: 「按回卷改」): a 卷 is ten 回 (his, 2026-09-29: 「按照1卷10回」「当前的都放到第一卷」); a 回 is one whole story, numbered through the whole book, with a 回目 of two matching seven-character lines (DESIGN.md § 回目). read-md.js bookEntries flattens it for the reader.
